verdict.rationale: Braintrust documents a public API reference that covers interacting with all aspects of the platform programmatically, including creating and managing projects, experiments, and datasets, logging traces, and managing prompts, tools, and scorers. First-party SDKs (JS, Python, Go, Java) and a CLI build on it. missing for 10: a discoverable machine-readable OpenAPI spec (the probe found 404 at all candidate paths), documented auth and rate-limit details for the API, and independent hands-on corroboration of driving the REST API.
